rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for both the act of explaining and an account that makes something understandable.

example.english: I don't understand this report; can you give me an explanation?
example.traditional: 我唔明白呢份報告，你可唔可以畀我個解釋？
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 ming4 baak6 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 ngo5 go3 gaai2 sik1

rows.note: Use this for a more formal explanatory statement or clarification, rather than the everyday default 解釋.

example.english: Please refer to the explanation in the contract.
example.jyutping: cing2 caam1 jyut6 hap6 joek3 noi6 ge3 syut3 ming4
